record.prompt: Add km_to_miles to units/convert.py, matching the style of the existing functions (type hints, one-line docstring), and use the exact inverse of the factor miles_to_km uses.
record.final_answer:
Added `km_to_miles` at units/convert.py:9, right after `miles_to_km`, same signature style and one-line docstring:

    def km_to_miles(km: float) -> float:
        """Convert kilometres to statute miles."""
        return km / 1.609344

Division by the same literal `1.609344` — the exact inverse, rather than a separately rounded `0.621371` constant. Verified round-tripping: `km_to_miles(miles_to_km(100)) == 100.0`, `miles_to_km(km_to_miles(42.0)) == 42.0`, and `km_to_miles(1.609344) == 1.0`.
